title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Judges 10: the judges Tola and Jair, Israel's turn to other gods, eighteen years of oppression and the cry for help.

questions.text: Tola the son of Puah was a man of which tribe?
questions.explanation: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel.

questions.text: On what did the thirty sons of Jair ride?
questions.explanation: Jair had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts.

questions.text: What were the thirty cities of Jair's sons called?
questions.explanation: They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, in the land of Gilead.
Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

questions.text: Into whose hands did Yahweh sell Israel when his anger burned against them?
questions.explanation: He sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

answers.text: The Midianites, the Amalekites and the children of the east
The Philistines and the children of Ammon

questions.text: For how many years did they oppress the Israelites beyond the Jordan in Gilead?
questions.explanation: For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, in Gilead.

questions.text: Against which tribes did the children of Ammon cross the Jordan to fight?
questions.explanation: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight against Judah, against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim.

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh tell the Israelites to go and cry in the time of their distress?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!"

answers.text: A prophet from the tribe of Judah

questions.text: What did the Israelites do after confessing that they had sinned?
questions.explanation: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh.

answers.text: They built a new altar at Bethel and offered sacrifices on it
They made a covenant with Ammon
They put away the foreign gods and served Yahweh
They chose a king over them

questions.text: Where did the children of Israel assemble and encamp when Ammon encamped in Gilead?
questions.explanation: The children of Ammon encamped in Gilead, and the children of Israel assembled themselves and encamped in Mizpah.
